sources.title: Florida Senate, 2026 section607.0824
sources.supports: Ordinary quorum is based on prescribed board size; approval uses directors present, with stated articles/bylaws, statutory and voting-right exceptions.

sources.title: Cayman Companies Act,2026Revision
sources.supports: At least two-thirds under the applicable voting basis, subject to higher articles threshold; polls use voting entitlements. Exclusion of abstentions is an inference from that denominator. Proxies count when permitted. Written unanimous resolution is a separate route.

sources.title: Delaware Code section242
sources.supports: Ordinary approval counts outstanding stock entitled to vote; class votes, higher charter thresholds and statutory exceptions apply. Eligible shares left unvoted remain in the denominator is an inference from the ordinary rule. Official consolidation checked through2026-10-01.
